```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded value'>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Top-level comment exercising parser comment state machine -->
  <sub:child id="c1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA block with <tags> & entities like &internal; inside ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % paramDTD "<!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA | subitem)*>">
  %paramDTD;
  <!ENTITY baseEnt "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY refEnt "&baseEnt; Extended">
]>
<?pi-target processing-instruction data="value"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://schemas.example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment right under root start -->
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA with special sequences: ]]> &refEnt; <![CDATA[ continuation
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY entA "A">
  <!ENTITY entB "&entA; B &entA;">
  <!ENTITY % pEnt "<!ENTITY entC '&entB; C'>">
  %pEnt;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-rng"?>
<doc xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:custom="http://example.org/custom">
  <!-- Multi-line comment
       spanning multiple lines
       with entities &entC; mentioned -->
  <custom:section>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA containing unescaped markup: <section> &entC; </section>
    ]]>
  </custom:section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY recordEnt "Standard Record">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <!ENTITY % macroDef "<!ATTLIST record status CDATA 'active'>">
  %macroDef;
]>
<?xml-debug level="high"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:meta="http://example.org/meta">
  <!-- Comment before metadata block -->
  <meta:info>
    <![CDATA[
      Metadata CDATA section.
    ]]>
  </meta:info>
  <record>&recordEnt;</record>
</archive>
```

<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY itemRef "ItemReference">
  <!ENTITY complexRef "&itemRef; &itemRef;">

  %extMacro;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.com/inventory" xmlns:ns1="http://example.com/ns1">

      CDATA segment with entities like &complexRef; and raw <>& characters.
    ]]>
  </ns1:item>
</inventory>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE note [
  <!ELEMENT note (body)*>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY bodyEnt "Important Note">
  <!ENTITY % localParam "<!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>">
  %localParam;
]>
<?target-pi data="processing instruction content"?>
<note xmlns="http://w3.org/1999/note" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Header comment -->
  <body xlink:type="locator">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with markup <body attr="val">&bodyEnt;</body>
    ]]>
  </body>
</note>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (table*)>
  <!ELEMENT table (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY t1 "Table1">
  <!ENTITY t2 "&t1; Table2">
  <!ENTITY % p1 "<!ENTITY t3 '&t2; Table3'>">
  %p1;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="db.xsl" type="text/xsl"?>
<database xmlns="http://example.com/db" xmlns:sql="http://example.com/sql">
  <!-- Comment detailing table entities -->
  <sql:table>
    <![CDATA[
      SQL query string inside CDATA: SELECT * FROM &t3;
    ]]>
  </sql:table>
</database>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE configuration [
  <!ELEMENT configuration (setting*)>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY setEnt "ConfigurationSetting">
  <!NOTATION confNotate SYSTEM "notation/conf">
  <!ENTITY confExt SYSTEM "conf.dat" NDATA confNotate>
  <!ENTITY % dtdMacro "<!ATTLIST setting id ID #IMPLIED>">
  %dtdMacro;
]>
<?conf-pi action="init"?>
<configuration xmlns="http://example.com/config" xmlns:cfg="http://example.com/config">
  <!-- Configuration comment block -->
  <setting id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Nested-looking comment inside CDATA -->
      Value: &setEnt;
    ]]>
  </setting>
</configuration>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (chapter*)>
  <!ELEMENT chapter (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY chapEnt "ChapterEntity">
  <!ENTITY compoundEnt "&chapEnt; -- appended">
  <!ENTITY % subMacro "<!ENTITY nestedEnt 'NestedValue'>">
  %subMacro;
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction key="value"?>
<document xmlns="http://example.org/doc" xmlns:chapter="http://example.org/chapter">
  <!-- Document start comment -->
  <chapter:chapter>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing entity reference &nestedEnt; and &compoundEnt;
    ]]>
  </chapter:chapter>
</document>
```
